description: Calculates wind on a bridge deck with the Wind Load Calculator plugin's own engine (formerly Eurocode Wind Loads). code EN: EN 1991-1-4 §8 — v_b, q_p(z_e), c_sc_d, d_tot, the transverse (x), longitudinal (y) and vertical (z, at e = ±b/4) forces, wind with traffic. code CS454: CS 454 Appendix D — Vs, Vd, Vr, C_D (Figure D.6), C_L, parapet, longitudinal, vertical (at the centroid) and live-load wind, or the cl 5.33.1 simplified model. Returns the load cases the plugin would write. Needs no model.

bridge.description: Deck inputs, metres. Omitted geometry is measured from the model (ec_wind_apply) — ec_wind_bridge needs b, d, L and groundToSoffit.

d1.description: Parapet / barrier height above the deck (m).

groundToSoffit.description: Height of the soffit above ground (for z_e).

method.description: general (default) or the simplified route the plugin offers.

restraint.description: Table 8.1 parapet/barrier case (plugin values, default none).

sides.description: Parapets on one or both sides (one|both).

structuralForm.description: normal (beam-and-slab / plate girder, default), box, slab, uDeck (half-through), portal (portal / box culvert / integral), truss, arch, cableStayed, suspension… — forms the chosen code does not cover need acknowledgeOutOfScope.

traffic.description: Traffic on the deck (none, road, rail). EN: the §8.3.1(5) case (higher of the barrier and the 2 m vehicle / 4 m train band). CS 454: the live-load case (d_L 2.5 m highway, 3.7 m rail, 1.25 m foot).

trafficLength.description: EN §8.3.1(5), road only: {mode: "whole"} (default) or {mode: "ranges", text: "0-20, 45-60"} — the loaded length(s) carrying traffic, in m along the span.

code.description: Design code: EN = EN 1991-1-4 §8 (with nationalAnnex); CS454 = CS 454 Rev 0 Appendix D (UK assessment), which ignores the EN climate inputs and uses cs454 instead. CS 454 loads are written nominal as C454W_ cases.

cs454.description: CS 454 Appendix D inputs (code: CS454). The deck geometry stays in bridge.

directionDeg.description: Wind direction from north for Sd; omit = unknown (Sd 1.0).

height.description: Height H above ground; default soffit + half the depth.

loadedLength.description: Horizontal wind loaded length; default L.

method.description: full = Appendix D; simplified = cl 5.33.1 6 kN/m² (highway, slab / beam-and-slab, L ≤ 20 m, b ≥ 10 m).

minBeams.description: Deck on I sections with more than 4 beams, or box girders: C_D at least 1.3. Tick it for PSC I and steel I girder decks.

parapetLong.description: Table D.17 parapet type for the longitudinal share (infill default).

parapetSolid.description: Solid depth per parapet, m (Table D.10).

seaKm.description: Distance from the sea, km (Table D.4 / D.5).

trussMembers.description: flat (default) or round truss members (Tables D.13 / D.14).

vb.description: Basic mean hourly wind speed Vb (Figure D.1), m/s.

directions.description: Global load directions to write, e.g. {"Z-": false}. Default: all six (X±, Y±, Z±).

nationalAnnex.description: EN only. Built-in annex id; default CEN.

vb0.description: Fundamental basic wind velocity v_b,0, m/s (CEN has no map).

name: ec_wind_bridge
title: Bridge wind loads (EN 1991-1-4 §8 or CS 454)
